scope: inner development only; same two audited inner partitions; outer validation/test excluded
fixed_search: one common lambda applied to scaled parameter and state penalties; 9 candidates per adapted structure; no extra joint-only search
step_diagnostic: compare 3 steps with 10 at lambda=1; not another model-selection dimension
query: strictly after fourth time block, unchanged
learned_epoch_selection: shared epoch per structure across both inner splits; check 0 and each 5 epochs; mean validation-to-prior ratio per track then min worse track
fixed_selection: same normalized two-track criterion; report both tracks separately; exact prior-only included
tie_rule: criterion tolerance 1e-8 for numerical equality only; fewer active variables first; prior then state then cl then parameter then joint; stronger fixed lambda next
limits: one seed; two inner splits; selecting and reporting on validation is optimistic, not outer performance; no new encoder/dynamics; no source exclusions; fixed prior and solver
